no-restricted-syntax.message: Do not read 'accessToken' from Web Storage — it is an httpOnly cookie set by the BFF. Use apiV1Fetch / fetchWithAuth (credentials: 'include').
Do not store 'accessToken' in Web Storage — keep it in the httpOnly cookie set by the BFF.
Do not read 'refreshToken' from Web Storage — it is an httpOnly cookie set by the BFF. Use apiV1Fetch / fetchWithAuth (credentials: 'include').
Do not store 'refreshToken' in Web Storage — keep it in the httpOnly cookie set by the BFF.
Hardcoded localhost URLs are not allowed in source files. Use NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL via lib/config.ts or the fetch helpers in lib/api.ts instead.
